**Fix Needed:** Replace `tool.function` with proper aliased name constructor:
```gleam
fn get_js_function_name(module: String, function: String) -> String {
  // module = "issue", function = "add" → "issue_add"
  // Special case: "stats" module just uses "stats"
  case module {
    "stats" -> "stats"
    _ -> module <> "_" <> function
  }
}

// Then in generate_tool_call:
let js_fn = get_js_function_name(tool.module, tool.function)
_ -> "const result = await " <> js_fn <> "(...Object.values(params || {}));\n ..."
```

**Why Important:** The generator creates `extension.js`. If not fixed, next `gleam build` + regenerate will break all tools again!
